project.name: rev-eval
project.description: Revature Evaluation Platform / PEP brownfield substrate
project.architecture: Local-first multi-service app with FastAPI microservices, Next.js frontend, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, MinIO, API Gateway, and optional Nginx.

graphify.generation_mode: AST/code graph update without LLM API key

corpus.verdict: Corpus is large enough that graph structure adds value.

limitations: No LLM API key was configured, so the generated graph is strongest for code structure, imports, symbols, routes, and docs already parseable locally.
Full semantic extraction for prose, PDFs, images, design intent, and richer cross-document inference requires a provider key such as GEMINI_API_KEY, OPENAI_API_KEY, or ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.
Manual verification was still used for service counts, route mapping, and unfinished feature checks.
